rationale: Lactate and glucose are abundant primary substrates; arginine provides supplemental C and N. Fermentation to butyrate, acetate, and CO₂ follows my known metabolism. Growth limited by N availability (3.5 mmol N available vs 3.5 needed for 0.50 /h). C balance: 72 in, 16.5 (biomass) + 24.5 (products) = 41 out, 30.5 as CO₂/formate.
